notes: Stop signatures for the Gmail web route (design 4.5). Same regex rules as linkedin.json. A Google sign-in or account-chooser page, including the password step (/challenge/pwd), is an expired session (gmail_logged_out: log in or copy the login again); any other /challenge/ page, or the verification texts, is gmail_security, which wins when both match (detect.SEVERITY).
